title: Respond to an RSVP email
summary: See what a schedule email looks like, send your RSVP, and check your confirmation and reminder.

steps.title: Find your Volunteer Schedule email
paragraphs: Search for “Volunteer Schedule” in the inbox for the address you gave your coordinator. If you’re expecting an email and can’t find it, check your spam or junk folder.

images.alt: Volunteer Schedule email listing a nursery assignment with its date and role above the orange RSVP to Request button.
images.caption: Example schedule email for a nursery assignment.

steps.title: Read the invitation
paragraphs: Check the date and the role listed for your assignment. Review any time or notes included in the email. If the email lists several dates, check each one before you respond.

steps.title: Send your RSVP
paragraphs: Tap or click “RSVP to Request” in the schedule email. On the page that opens, choose whether you can serve and follow the prompts to submit your response.

steps.title: Check your confirmation email
paragraphs: Look for an email from Breeze Church Management with “Thanks for RSVPing” in the subject. Check that the response beside your assignment matches what you sent. The example below shows an accepted assignment.

images.alt: Thanks for RSVPing email showing an Accepted badge next to the nursery assignment and a Change Response button below it.
images.caption: Example confirmation email after accepting an assignment.

steps.title: Read your serving reminder
paragraphs: When the Volunteer Reminder email arrives, check the date, role, and RSVP status to confirm your assignment.

images.alt: Volunteer Reminder email listing an accepted nursery assignment with its date and role and a Change Selected RSVP Option button below.
images.caption: Example reminder email for an upcoming assignment.

steps.title: Change your response if plans change
paragraphs: Use “Change Response” in the confirmation email or “Change Selected RSVP Option” in the reminder. If the link doesn’t work or you need help confirming your RSVP, contact your team coordinator and include the service date.
